partners.mechanism_chain: L1CAM (HGNC:6554) —DISRUPTS→ neuronal cell migration and axon guidance (GO:0007411); neuronal cell migration and axon guidance (GO:0007411) —LEADS_TO→ X-linked hydrocephalus (MONDO:0010611); MAPK1 (HGNC:6871) —INCREASES→ RAS-MAPK signaling pathway (WP:WP529); RAS-MAPK signaling pathway (WP:WP529) —LEADS_TO→ Noonan syndrome 13 (MONDO:0033669).
